scorecard.rationale: A powder capsule pilot showed inconclusively slower upper-gut transit. Piperine and extract experiments give mixed bowel proxies. The human mixed-tablet pilot has conflicting counts and no controls. Cracked black pepper and clinical Parkinson constipation remain unresolved. Related cultural/experiential records (1) provide uncontrolled context without changing the open efficacy rating. The autism review mentions constipation as clinical context and piperine in a separate developmental-mouse model. The primary piperine abstract has no constipation endpoint. No cracked-black-pepper Parkinson result.
